cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states the objectives: to model normative trajectories of rsFC, quantify deviations in ASD males, and examine associations with social behavior and executive function.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: We evaluated whether individual variations in functional connectivity deviations map to social behavior in ASD males... We hypothesized that executive dysfunction would significantly mediate the association between rsFC deviations and social difficulties.
